speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Please describe your headache in detail, including its location, quality, and whether you have noticed any specific visual changes, such as flashes, floaters, or blurriness.

speaker: Patient
text: 69-year-old woman. The patient reports a 3-week history of headache and progressively worsening vision. She has not noticed any other symptoms, including no recent weight changes, no fevers, no night sweats, and no pain elsewhere in the body.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. To help narrow down the cause of your headache and vision changes, could you tell me if you are experiencing any visual field loss, such as missing part of your vision, or if you see halos around lights? Additionally, have you noticed any pain when looking at bright lights (photophobia)?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Headache. I also have Worsening vision over the past 3 weeks, No weight changes, No fevers, No night sweats, No other pain.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Giant Cell Arteritis (Temporal Arteritis).

Given your age, new-onset headache, and progressive vision loss without fever or weight change, I am immediately concerned for this condition. I need to confirm if you have experienced jaw pain while chewing or scalp tenderness, and I request a request for a complete blood count (CBC) with differential and ESR results. REQUEST TEST: CBC_with_Differential and ESR.
